items.title: Zeta Global Holdings (ZETA) Refreshes Its Leadership Team With Two Senior Roles
items.summary: Zeta Global Holdings (NYSE:ZETA) appointed Leah Pope as Chief Marketing Officer, bringing experience from firms such as Salesforce and Adobe. The company promoted Candace Dean to Chief Communications Officer, expanding her remit over corporate and stakeholder messaging. These leadership moves highlight a focus on brand, market positioning, and communication at a time when prior updates have centered on earnings, guidance, and valuation. This kind of leadership shift is not unique to Zeta...
